conventions.frame: Per card. Origin = top-left corner of the card seen from the component side. +x along the long edge to the right; +y DOWN towards the slot edge (y = 0 is the top/clip edge, y = 47 sits in the floor slot); +z out of the component side. z = 0 is the component-side copper surface, the solder-side surface is z = -1.6. NOTE: (x, y-down, z-out) is LEFT-handed; for a right-handed frame use v = 47 - y (v up) with the same x and z.
conventions.rotation_deg: KiCad footprint orientation, counter-clockwise as seen from the component side (KiCad convention, y down).
conventions.origin: KiCad footprint anchor in card coordinates (usually pin 1).
conventions.groups: bodies = the part as fitted (component side, z >= 0); solder = lead/tail protrusion below the board (z <= -1.6) after trimming; mated = mating plug or plug-in module that is not soldered (present in service); cable = keep-clear zone for the wire bundle as it leaves the plug (includes a bend allowance); service = space needed to fit/remove the plug or module (not occupied in service).
conventions.lead_exit: Unit vector (card frame) in which wires leave the mated plug, plus the face centre they leave from.
conventions.source: Each shape carries "src": datasheet | footprint | estimate. "datasheet" dimensions are from the PDF named in "ref_doc" (manifest: datasheets/MANIFEST.json); "footprint" = KiCad F.Fab outline; "estimate" = not yet confirmed - add margin.
conventions.status: Geometry derived from footprints and datasheets. Not a measured/physical fit.
